title: Authenticate European Star Cross compact bank
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static source plan
changes: Authenticate the remaining source-backed selectors and list geometry in the existing Star Cross compact bank.
validation: Protected unit liuwuxg7 checks 2,116 unowned source bytes in selectors 0/1 and 23 lists, all observed on the bus; 2,014 list bytes were also observed by sprite peeks. Existing E291 bank projection is preserved.
limitations: The source plan does not implement runtime consumption or establish individual selector timing, all callers, other scenes, Linux, USA or native Windows. No performance comparison was made.
